integrity: Analytical proof includes the Gaussian radial normalization, exact extreme-order conditional CDF, independent two-tail limit, and beta-gamma cumulant derivation; a reproducible numerical checker provides corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact moments involve numerical integrals; the explicit limiting distribution is for balanced parts, without a rate or unequal-part theorem; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact width moments and a Bessel-square fluctuation law for complete-bipartite symmetric edge polytopes
